description:
## Pre-auth (Card holds)
Pre-authorisation flow: after a `purchase`, complete (capture) or cancel the hold. Use `pre-auth-completion` optionally with a **payout** split.

Order of fields in the hash differs per request - read the description before editing values.

request.description:
## ⚡ Quick test
1. Create the hold first: set `{{purchase_type}}` = `pre-auth` → run **03 → 1. Purchase** → then send this (it reads `{{last_tran_id}}` and captures `{{amount}}`).
2. RSA needed (node-forge or `{{preauth_merchant_auth}}`). Prefer releasing the funds? Use **3. Cancel Pre-auth** instead.

## Complete Pre-auth
RSA payload: `{ "mc_id": "...", "tran_id": "...", "complete_amount": "..." }`
Hash: `merchant_auth + request_time + merchant_id` (note: merchant_auth FIRST).
Without node-forge, set `{{preauth_merchant_auth}}`.

if (!__h) throw new Error('The `__helpers` collection variable is missing - re-import the full collection JSON (it holds the shared helper library source).');
var payload = { mc_id: C.get('merchant_id'), tran_id: tranId, complete_amount: fmtAmt(C.get('amount')) };
// Restore the shared PayWay helper library (Postman runs every script in its own scope):

pm.test('SKIPPED - RSA payload not configured', function () { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); });

console.log('SKIPPED: the gateway needs an RSA-encrypted merchant_auth. Install the node-forge library (collection > Libraries) or paste a pre-computed value into the fallback variable - see the request description.');

request.description:
## ⚡ Quick test
1. Same setup as request 1, but the captured amount is split to beneficiaries — set `{{payout_json}}` (`[{"acc":"...","amt":0.05}]`) first.
2. RSA needed (node-forge or `{{preauth_payout_merchant_auth}}`).

## Complete Pre-auth with Payout
Same endpoint/order as the plain completion, but the RSA payload also carries a `payout` array:
`{ "mc_id": "...", "tran_id": "...", "complete_amount": "...", "payout": [{ "acc": "...", "amt": "...", "reason": "..." } | ...] }`
Hash: `merchant_auth + request_time + merchant_id`.
Without node-forge, set `{{preauth_payout_merchant_auth}}`.

// Complete Pre-auth + payout - RSA payload with payout array; hash: merchant_auth+request_time+merchant_id
else { payouts = [{ acc: '000133879', amt: amount, reason: 'test' }]; }

if (String(code) === '0' || String(code) === '00') { console.log('Pre-auth captured with payout split.'); }
